name: QuoxAgent Tools
description: Quox Helper Agent tools for remote command execution and fleet management

tools.name: Execute Command
tools.description: Execute a shell command on a remote host via QuoxAgent agent

instructions.summary: Execute shell commands on remote hosts in the QuoxAgent fleet
when_to_use: User wants to run a command on a specific server
User asks 'run X on host Y'
User needs to check something on a remote host
when_not_to_use: Read-only metrics are available via Prometheus (use prometheus tools)
User wants to modify system configuration (use specialized tools or require explicit approval)
Command is destructive (rm -rf, format, etc.) - escalate to human

output_interpretation.success: exitCode: 0 with stdout containing command output
output_interpretation.empty: Empty stdout with exitCode 0 means command succeeded with no output
output_interpretation.error: Non-zero exitCode with stderr containing error message

error_recovery.action: Verify command exists on target host, check PATH
Command exists but not executable, check permissions
Increase timeout or check if command is hanging

tools.name: Fleet Status
tools.description: The QuoxAgent sidecars' own self-reported health: which agents report themselves healthy, degraded or unhealthy, and their connection state. Use for asks about the sidecars or agents reporting their own health. For the Bastion host inventory (which hosts exist, IPs, reachability) use fleet_status.

instructions.summary: Check health and connectivity of all hosts in the fleet
when_to_use: User asks 'how many hosts are online?'
User wants to see fleet overview
Before executing commands to verify host is reachable
when_not_to_use: User needs detailed host metrics (use prometheus)

tools.name: Install Agent
tools.description: Install QuoxAgent agent on a new host

hostId.description: Target host ID to install agent on

instructions.summary: Deploy QuoxAgent agent to a new host for fleet management
when_to_use: User wants to add a new host to the fleet
when_not_to_use: Host already has agent installed (check with quoxagent.status first)
User doesn't have SSH access to target

tools.name: Get Agent Logs
tools.description: Retrieve recent logs from a QuoxAgent agent

lines.description: Number of log lines to retrieve

instructions.summary: Get recent logs from a QuoxAgent agent for debugging
Manage and execute commands on remote hosts via the QuoxAgent fleet
when_to_use: User wants to run commands on remote servers
User needs to check fleet/host status
User wants to deploy agents to new hosts
Infrastructure management tasks requiring shell access
when_not_to_use: Read-only metrics are available via Prometheus (prefer prometheus tools)
Task can be done with specialized tool (prefer specific tool)

output_interpretation.success: Returns command output in stdout with exitCode 0
output_interpretation.empty: Empty response may indicate command produced no output
output_interpretation.error: Non-zero exitCode indicates failure, check stderr for details

error_recovery.action: Check network connectivity, verify agent is running
Increase timeout or investigate if command is blocking
May need sudo, check user permissions on target
Verify command is installed, check PATH
